These are the {{< var n_postings >}} senior-eligible postings from {{< var n_companies >}} employers that the
[report](../report/index.qmd) analyses, as fetched on {{< var fetched >}}. Each links to the employer's own page;
postings close, so a dead link means the role is gone. The skill tags are the skills the description names
(green means you already know that skill, from your [review](../review/index.qmd) progress).
Refresh the list with `python tools/fetch_jobs.py && python tools/analyze_skills.py`.

<div id="jobs-app"><noscript>The jobs browser needs JavaScript.</noscript></div>
